summary: @ornikar/react-native-svg-transformer preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods the `bun` binary executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball (`execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, "math_init.js")])`). `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using string-array rotation (`WV8StW`), a char-code decoder (`hc1jfK9`) with a custom alphabet, and mangled global identifiers — its runtime behavior cannot be resolved without executing it. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of transforming SVGs for React Native Metro. Additionally, `package.json` declares `files: ["index.js","CHANGELOG.md","README.md"]`, but both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped outside that manifest. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) sidesteps Node-based install-time monitoring; the upstream `react-native-svg-transformer` package has no such preinstall hook or bundled binary payload, consistent with a hostile fork or compromised scoped release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
